walkthroughs.body_html: Spirals have lots of gas and ongoing star formation. Ellipticals are gas-poor with mostly older, redder stars. Irregulars often result from gravitational disruption or galaxy interactions.
Andromeda and the Milky Way are approaching at ~110 km/s and will merge in ~4-5 billion years, likely forming a giant elliptical galaxy nicknamed Milkomeda.
For 'compare galaxy types' answers: state shape, list stellar populations (old vs young), comment on gas/dust and star formation rate, then give a named example for each.
